title: Success Criteria tabs: improved interaction states + distinct Impact/90-Day controls

requirements.summary: Add clear hover, focus, and selected visual states for Success Criteria tab buttons (including Impact and 90-Day Plan) in light/dark mode without layout shift.
acceptanceCriteria: On desktop, hovering any tab button (including Impact and 90-Day Plan) visibly changes its styling (e.g., background, border, or text color) without causing layout shift.
Using keyboard navigation (Tab + arrow keys/Enter/Space as applicable), the focused tab button has a visible focus indicator.
The currently selected success-criteria tab has a clearly distinct selected styling that is different from the hover styling.
Hover/focus/selected styles work in both light and dark modes.

file_operations.description: Update the shadcn-ui Tabs/TabsTrigger consuming styles (do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui) to add explicit hover, focus-visible, and data-[state=active] selected styles for all tab-like controls (the four criteria triggers plus the Impact and 90-Day Plan triggers). Keep border width consistent (e.g., always border-2) and use transitions that avoid any layout shift. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add/adjust a small, reusable styling hook (e.g., a component-layer utility class) for Success Criteria tab interaction states if needed to ensure consistent hover/focus/selected behavior across light and dark themes, without modifying shadcn UI component source. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Make Impact and 90-Day Plan controls render as two distinct buttons and ensure each scrolls only to its correct section target without label overlap at any viewport size.
acceptanceCriteria: “Impact” and “90-Day Plan” render as two distinct tab/button elements with readable labels at all common viewport sizes (mobile through desktop).
Clicking/tapping “Impact” scrolls to the section with id="impact" and does not scroll to the roadmap section.
Clicking/tapping “90-Day Plan” scrolls to the section with id="roadmap" and does not scroll to the impact section.
No label text overlap/overwriting occurs between these two controls at any viewport size.

file_operations.description: Adjust the Success Criteria module layout so “Impact” and “90-Day Plan” are clearly separated as two distinct controls (e.g., enforce spacing/gap, consistent min heights, and responsive wrapping so labels never overlap). Ensure onClick handlers remain correctly bound: Impact triggers scrollToSection('impact') only; 90-Day Plan triggers scrollToSection('roadmap') only. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
